name: 01-valid-chain
description: A complete incident: boot, self-test, gas elevated, heat agrees, CRITICAL, photos, three alerts, one ack, one timeout.

name: 02-tampered-payload
description: Entry 3 has its gas score rewritten from 68 to 12; the hash no longer matches the contents.

name: 03-broken-prev-link
description: Entry 4 points at a prev_hash that is not the hash of entry 3.

name: 04-bad-signature
description: Entry 2 keeps a valid hash chain but its signature has one flipped byte.

name: 05-sequence-gap
description: Entry 4 is deleted; the sequence jumps from 3 to 5.

name: 06-reordered-entries
description: Entries 2 and 3 are swapped, so the sequence goes 0, 1, 3, 2.

name: 07-truncated-middle
description: Four entries covering the alarm are cut out of the middle of the log.

name: 08-wrong-device-id
description: Entry 2 was written by a different device and re-signed with that device key.

name: 09-media-hash-mismatch
description: The chain verifies, but the exported images do not include the frames the log names.

name: 10-genesis-prev-not-zero
description: The first entry has a prev_hash of zero but claims seq 5.
